Create polished cinematic key art for JOSEON HUNTERS based on the attached references. Wide landscape 16:9 composition. NO text or logo.
Image 1: approved Doho catalogue, use ONLY RIGHTMOST D03 identity. Image 2: developed D03 full-body/face master, preserve his face, black heukrip with blue round ornament and bead cords, deep navy layered dopo, white crossed collar, muted red sash, round blue waist pendant, black trousers and laced boots. Image 3: target stone dungeon environment, use its worn Korean granite material and seal motif, not its exact map composition.
ONE hero only: Doho, a young adult Korean wandering sword-wielding Taoist with a small knowing smirk and loose confident swagger, on center-right taking his first downward step into a breached subterranean stone entrance. His sword rests casually across ONE shoulder in his right hand, with blade and hilt anatomically clear and entirely in frame. Free hand loosely adjusts his sash. Show full body, entire hat brim and all feet, stepping from a higher stone tread to a lower one. Hat does not hide both eyes. No scarf, no brown robe, no magic cast from his hand.
Composition: hero occupies 60% image height and center-right 60% of canvas; lower-left contains descending granite steps leading the eye inward; upper-left 25% is a quieter shadowed wall plane with usable negative space for future typography. A large old seal-marked rectangular stone doorway frames him, faint blue light leaking from ONE narrow crack. Tiny warm torch behind and above him motivates gentle warm reflected light; restrained cool stone shadows in front. A glimpse of weathered Korean tiled eave at distant entrance hints the outside village. No other characters, no monster collage.
Korean folklore adventure with playful nerve, graceful confident action language, not gore horror. Matte painterly illustrated rendering, controlled contrast, readable navy silhouette separated by value, physically motivated soft lighting. No neon cyan rim, no bloom, no neon sword, no flying glowing paper, no particle storm, no photoreal celebrity face, no UI. Use the selected clothing and facial identity accurately. Keep critical character and sword safely within outer 8% margin.

records.title: 3인방 세계관 포스터
records.prompt:
Create an ensemble world poster illustration for JOSEON HUNTERS, a fictional Joseon Korean folklore adventure. Wide landscape 16:9, no text, no logo, no interface. The three attached character masters are IDENTITY references: image 1 DOHO D03, image 2 GWISAE G02, image 3 CHEONGYEON C01. Preserve their faces or mask, costumes, colors, hair and signature props accurately. Image 4 supplies village architectural material and place identity.
EXACTLY THREE adult protagonists. Doho at front center is the clear lead and slightly larger, his weight relaxed on one leg with a knowing smirk, black wide brim hat with round blue ornament/bead cords, deep navy layered dopo white collar muted red sash blue waist pendant, black trousers/boots. He holds ONE sword resting across his right shoulder, its long blade on an upward diagonal staying clear of other heads and fully inframe. No scarf.
Gwisae left and half-step behind, adult woman wearing ivory gaksi theatrical mask with red dots, black high ponytail, crimson/black short split coat and purple inner, dark trousers/boots, two spare masks on left hip. One curved dagger lowered at her side, red ribbon trailing mildly. Do not reveal an invented unmasked face.
Cheongyeon right and half-step behind, serene adult woman with black braided long hair and compact black/gold headpiece, ivory/celadon long hanbok, subtle gold bird embroidery, jade waist pendant. Black celestial folding fan opened at chest and brass bells held low; hands, fan and bell chain anatomically clear.
Place them in a calm but charged triangular portrait composition in Motgol's worn stone market lane: closed wooden stalls, tiled hanok rooflines, a pond and small pavilion in the middle distance. Early evening warm lanterns with cool muted sky. A distant fissure in a stone gateway carries only a trace of blue; no battle. Costume colors form navy center, crimson left, ivory right without washing together.
All three heads and feet visible, each silhouette distinct with clean gaps around arms/props. Figures occupy about 70% of image height in the lower two-thirds. Keep top quarter quieter with soft roofline and dusk sky for future typography. Human scale and perspective consistent, no giant floating faces, no fourth character or fox-tail frame. Moody playful confidence and camaraderie, expressive Korean fantasy illustration, matte painterly textures, restrained lighting and no neon rim, glow storm, guns, gore or generic medieval European architecture. A WORLD/CAST poster, not a screenshot of three playable classes.

records.title: 기존 컷4 — 봉인 벽
records.prompt:
Create a cinematic story illustration for JOSEON HUNTERS, scene "The Seal Wall" (existing narrative cut 4). Wide 16:9 landscape, no text, no caption, no logo or UI.
Reference 1 is DOHO D03 face/costume identity: preserve young adult Korean man, black wide-brim heukrip blue ornament/bead cords, deep navy layered robe, white collar, muted red sash, round blue pendant, black trousers/laced boots, no scarf. Reference 2 is NPC sheet: use ONLY the MIDDLE elderly shaman grandmother design, with lined elderly Korean face, grey hair in traditional tied style, muted worn multicolored hanbok, small fan and brass bells; ignore merchant and village elder. Reference 3 supplies dungeon material vocabulary, worn dark Korean granite and restrained blue seal crack.
Scene at the subterranean dungeon entrance on the outskirts of Motgol. A massive rectangular ancient stone door and seal wall occupies the right half. Old seal marks on the wall subtly tremble, one thin irregular crack leaks quiet blue light. The seal has ALREADY been damaged before the heroes arrive; no one is cutting or shattering it.
Doho stands left of center in three-quarter side view facing right toward the crack. His usual smirk has briefly settled into quiet alert concentration; an eye under the hat remains visible in profile. He has lowered his SINGLE sword from his shoulder and now holds it correctly one-handed beside his thigh, blade diagonally DOWN toward the floor, not touching the wall or anyone. His other hand rests naturally near his sash. Weight planted, no attack pose, no spellcasting. Elderly shaman grandma stands a step BEHIND him at far left, giving a short calm explanation and gesturing toward the old seal with her closed fan. She is a little shorter than him, physically present and not a transparent ghost.
Medium-wide eye-level cinematic framing with both figures shown from head to at least lower calves and ample frame margins. Foreground scattered old stone chips, lattice-like carving and worn stairs disappearing just beside the door. Warm torchlight from behind them at left contrasts with cool seal light on the near edge of their faces at right. Faces and clothing readable with soft secondary bounce; no bright blue rimlight wrapping whole bodies. Darkness deeper into the passage. Suspense and curiosity in a folk adventure, not despair or horror.
Matte painterly Korean fantasy illustration consistent with references, restrained atmosphere, no glowing particles, no energy beams, no neon runes carpet, no monsters, no Gwisae, Cheongyeon or Gumiho. No newly invented additional characters, no gore, no giant magic circle. Concentrate on the shared pause before entering.

superseded.title: 흑랑 최초 시안 — 잘못된 크기 비교 표시로 교체
superseded.prompt:
Create a production creature concept sheet for HEUKRANG, a giant black wolf demon boss in JOSEON HUNTERS. Landscape 3:2, warm ivory neutral background, polished matte painterly illustrated rendering consistent with input style anchor. Input hero is only for illustration language; do not copy clothes onto wolf.
Show one large dominant three-quarter view at left and a smaller exact side profile at upper right plus a close-up of head at lower right. SAME creature in all views. Thick four-legged wolf anatomy with high muscular shoulders, lowered predatory head, powerful haunches, broad paws, long bushy tail. Coat charcoal-black with very restrained blue-black planes; sculpted layered fur clumps imply smoke-like movement but are solid fur, NOT a cloud replacing anatomy. Small red eyes clearly focal, teeth visible in a restrained snarl, no blood. Target fictional game boss scale about 2.4 units tall; convey size with a tiny simple grey Doho silhouette at bottom, not numerical dimensions.
Large clean silhouette suitable for low-poly translation. Four limbs unambiguous and separated; no extra horns, antlers, armor, chains or unrequested decorations. Fur masses broad instead of thousands of hair strands. No flaming paws, no glow outline or particles, no background landscape. One small top heading "HEUKRANG", labels "PROFILE" and "HEAD" allowed, no other text. Full tail/paws/ears inside frame. Mysterious Korean monster adventure, powerful creature rather than gore-horror.
